title: AI design patterns
author: Jing Hu
description: Reusable design patterns for AI products, written down from products designed by Jing Hu.

themes.name: AI across modes
themes.lede: Answers that cross text, images, audio, clips and buttons, and the design work of letting information flow between them.
themes.intro: A recording, an image or a long document holds an enormous amount of decision-relevant information, but the cost of getting it out has always been too high. Multimodal AI changes that: it can read a frame, find the seconds that matter, and write an answer that mixes words, pictures and clips. The question that sits under every pattern in this theme is the one I get asked most at work: when an answer crosses text, images, clips and action buttons, how should that information flow?

themes.name: AI for accessibility
themes.lede: Designing for as many senses as possible, and finding that the structure AI adds to content is the same structure accessibility has always asked for.
themes.intro: I like designing for as many senses as possible: operating a product with the keyboard alone, making sense of it with no sound, or making sense of it with no picture. Once content has structure, can be read and can be asked, it becomes friendlier to screen readers, silent use, keyboard navigation, low-bandwidth connections, older users and people with cognitive differences. In the work this site is drawn from, accessibility was not a patch after launch. It was the foundation.

stages.name: Ask
stages.text: The person has a question, or a thing they want to find.

stages.name: Answer
stages.text: The AI returns something: an excerpt, a marker, a segment, a generated answer.

stages.name: Check
stages.text: The person looks at the evidence and decides whether to believe it.

stages.name: Decide
stages.text: The person acts: proceeds, moves on, or corrects the AI.

article-d.title: From watching to asking: how AI is reshaping how we consume shopping videos
article-d.note: A feature about my work at Amazon; the patterns on this site are my own English write-up of the same work, stated so that they apply beyond it.

updates.text: Patterns rewritten so they apply to AI products in any field; the work they come from stays as the example under each. The shopping theme is folded into the others.
Every pattern now opens with what users needed, and the Method page explains how a pattern runs from a user need to a result.
Site opened with the first eight patterns, all from the video shopping work covered in the multimodal theme.
